mailtpl.deleteUnknownConfirm: Delete the template? It belongs to no mail this version sends.
mailtpl.isHtmlHint: The body is then HTML. Both are still sent — an HTML-only message scores worse with spam filters, so MatCMS derives the text version for you. Inserted values are escaped, so nobody can write markup into somebody else’s inbox through a form.
mailtpl.loopsHint: Everything between {{#name}} and {{/name}} is written once per entry — the same notation the template engine uses for menus.

settings.mailNoneHint: This site cannot send e-mail: no SMTP server configured and no cloud relay active. Form notifications and password mails will not go out.

plugins.filesHelp: JSON map of path → content. A folder is nothing but a “/” in the path, e.g. {"Elements/Hero.csx": "…"} — and it comes into being with its first file. #load "Elements/Hero.csx" is resolved from the plugin root; from a file inside Elements/, #load "Hero.csx" also finds its neighbour. A plugin only sees its own files.
plugins.folderFirstFile: A folder comes into being with its first file. Name of that file in
plugins.folderNothingCreated: No folder created — without a first file it cannot be stored.
plugins.folderDeleteConfirm: Delete this folder and the {0} file(s) in it?
plugins.deleteSaveHint: This only becomes final when you save.
plugins.pathInvalid: Invalid name. Separate folders with “/”; “..”, the bundle format’s “assets” branch, the folder carrying the role “Assets” and “plugin.csx” are not possible.
plugins.moveAsk: Target folder — empty means the plugin root
plugins.moveIntoSelf: A folder cannot be moved into itself.
plugins.pathExists: “{0}” already exists here. Nothing was overwritten — pick another name.

{0}

{0}

plugins.assetDeleteHint: This file lives on disk and is gone immediately — unlike a script file.

plugins.assetDeleteConfirm: Really remove this file from the server?
plugins.assetUnsaved: Uploading and removing reload the page — unsaved changes to the code would be lost. Continue anyway?
plugins.filePick: Pick a file on the left, or create one.

plugins.mappingBroken: The “Folder roles” field under “Advanced” is not valid JSON — please fix it there.
plugins.includeFolderTitle: Role “Include” — every file in here runs before the entry file, alphabetically
plugins.roleAssetsTaken: The folder “{0}” already carries the role “Assets”. There is only one directory on disk — take it away there first.
plugins.roleAssetsNotEmpty: “{0}” contains the script file “{1}”. An assets folder holds files from disk — move the script files out first.
plugins.roleAssetsNeeded: This plugin has {0} uploaded file(s). Without a folder carrying the role “Assets” they could no longer be reached — rename it instead of taking its role away.
plugins.rolesHelp: Folder roles: folder names are free — the role in the context menu (“Mapping …”) decides what happens to the files inside. Assets: the files live on disk and are served at /plugin-assets/<key>/<file>; the folder name in the tree is only a label — renaming it changes no URL. At most one folder can carry it. Include: every file inside (including subfolders) runs before the entry file, in alphabetical order of its path, without #load. An additional #load of the same file does not run it twice. Without a role set, everything stays as before.
plugins.bpAlready: This blueprint is already in “{0}” — nothing will be inserted.
plugins.bpNewFile: The file is empty and will be written without asking.
plugins.bpNotLoaded: Careful: “{0}” is not currently loaded — it is neither the entry file, nor inside an include folder, nor reached by a #load. The inserted code would not run.

plugins.bpAdminPageDesc: AddAdminMenu + AddAdminPage: an entry in the sidebar and the page behind it, including a form that posts back to itself.
plugins.bpBlockDesc: AddBlock with fields: the editor maintains them in the block editor, the plugin reads them at runtime from req.Data.
plugins.bpConfigDesc: Config("…") with a default — lets a plugin be configured without editing it.
plugins.bpPublicFormDesc: AddPublicPage + a block with a form: take input from the website and redirect back to the same page.
plugins.bpStoreDesc: The plugin's data as JSON in a SiteSetting — where the backup picks it up.

components.fieldsHelp: Every field is asked for in the block editor. The label becomes the {{field}} placeholder for the template; renaming keeps the old placeholder so blocks already placed keep working.
